1809-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3240-5231-6462-8347.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1164-4740-6333-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
1164-4740-6333-6900.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Hades, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Gwenom.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
1164-4740-6333-6900.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

1477-3764-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least X cards in all hands.
3899-6972-7234.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1170-2981-4985-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-4985-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

824-2728-4050-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-4050-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-4050-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

2459-2997-3558-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-2997-3558-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1394-2034-2060-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2730-4050-7706.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing White Widow, adding {B}.
When White Widow dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning White Widow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When White Widow enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to White Widow.
Repeat.

856-4321-6798-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-6798-7422.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6968-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-6968-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6968-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Kratos so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6664-7296.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-6664-7296.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-5627-7201.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5627-7201.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-5627-7201.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

579-2366-3480-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-3480-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

967-997-3809-5184-7087.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4699-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

147-413-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Incarnation Technique.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3234-3293-5226-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5226-6797.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5226-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1263-2060-2438-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-2438-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

2131-4574-6687-6688.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
2131-4574-6687-6688.description:
Cast Arcbound Reclaimer by paying {4}.
When Arcbound Reclaimer enters the battlefield, Sarinth Steelseeker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting an artifact creature card from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Sarinth Steelseeker ability, putting the artifact creature card from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Unshakable Tail triggers, creating a Clue token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Sarinth Steelseeker triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1399-1606-2404-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
1399-1606-2404-4875.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

813-3563-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Flicker of Fate.
813-3563-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1737-2981-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

232-2948-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
232-2948-5553-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand by paying {R}, adding {B}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Urabrask and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1766-3767-3918-4452.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
1766-3767-3918-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
1766-3767-3918-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1652-1912-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Patron of the Arts.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2254-4823-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 2 or less.
2254-4823-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing Timeless Witness, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Timeless Witness's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2510-3682-4518-5542.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

69-539-2026-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Voyaging Satyr do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-2026-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-2026-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

736-2232-2751-3475-4768.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You have at least one non-Saga enchantment card in hand.
736-2232-2751-3475-4768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and targeting it, copying The World Spell's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The World Spell's trigger, putting Copy Enchantment and any non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Choose to have Copy Enchantment enter the battlefield as a copy of The World Spell, with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Copy Enchantment triggers once, and Cloudstone Curio and Altar of the Brood each trigger twice.
Resolve both Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Copy Enchantment and any other non-Saga enchantment from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment trigger, putting it and the non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

466-1940-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
466-1940-2034.description:
Activate Saproling Cluster by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Liliana triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-4089.notablePrerequisites:
Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4089.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4089.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

146-1148-2542.description:
Cast Slaughter Pact, choosing to pay its replicate cost at least ten times per opponent you have, by paying a total of {0}, targeting Venerated Rotpriest.
Venerated Rotpriest and Slaughter Pact's replicate ability trigger.
Resolve the Slaughter Pact trigger, creating a copy for each time its replicate cost was paid, with each copy targeting Venerated Rotpriest.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each copy targeting it this way.
Resolve the first Venerated Rotpriest trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 5 until the opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.
Repeat from step 5 for each remaining opponent.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2290-3097-4050-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2290-3097-4050-4186.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-3324.notablePrerequisites: Steward of Solidarity does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3324.description:
Activate Steward of Solidarity by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Warrior token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat

950-3525-3756.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3525-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
